actions.editHint: Click on values to edit them

payments.noPayments: No payments recorded for this shift.

cashReconciliation.title: Cash reconciliation
cashReconciliation.notCountedDescription: The shift was closed without recording physical cash.
cashReconciliation.balancedDescription: Counted cash matches the expected drawer.
cashReconciliation.shortageDescription: The drawer is {{amount}} below expected cash.
cashReconciliation.overageDescription: The drawer is {{amount}} above expected cash.

toast.deletedDesc: The shift has been successfully deleted
toast.updatedDesc: The shift has been successfully updated

correctCount.title: Correct the closeout count
correctCount.sameAmount: It is the same amount the closeout already has
correctCount.changed: Someone changed this count while you were correcting it; reload the page

blocked.SHIFT_NOT_CLOSED: The closeout is not closed yet
blocked.EXTERNAL_POS: This closeout comes from another system (such as SoftRestaurant); its count cannot be corrected from Avoqado
blocked.NOT_COUNTED: This closeout was closed without a count; there is no count to correct
blocked.NO_LINKED_DRAWER: This closeout has no linked cash drawer (it predates Sep 3 or used no drawer); ask support to correct it
blocked.DRAWER_NOT_CLOSED: This closeout's cash drawer is still open or was closed without a count
blocked.NO_SIGNED_DIFFERENCE: This closeout has no signed difference to correct
blocked.COUNT_MISMATCH: The drawer and the shift do not match; tell support
blocked.TOO_MANY: This closeout already has 50 corrections; ask support for help

drawer.title: Physical cash drawer
drawer.subtitle: The drawer your POS and terminal open and close: starting cash, cash sales, pay-ins, pay-outs and the count at close. The shifts above are sales per shift; this is the physical money.
drawer.noneOpen: No drawer is open right now.
drawer.empty: No drawer sessions yet. They show up here as soon as your POS opens the first one.

cashMachineDoubts.title: Cash machine payments in doubt
cashMachineDoubts.tooltip: Cash machine payments whose outcome the PC could not record.
cashMachineDoubts.intro: The cash machine PC could not tell how these payments ended. Go to the machine, check its screen or receipt, and record here what happened. The PC picks it up automatically.
cashMachineDoubts.loadError: The list could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
cashMachineDoubts.empty: No payments in doubt. Everything from the machine is recorded.

resolve.title: Resolve payment {{folio}}

PAGADO.label: It was paid
PAGADO.hint: The machine received the full amount due. The sale is recorded.

CANCELADO.label: Cancelled and refunded
CANCELADO.hint: The payment was cancelled and the machine returned the money it took.

GUARDADO.label: Cancelled and kept the money
GUARDADO.hint: The payment was cancelled and the machine kept what it took without returning it.

resolve.receiptTimeHelp: If you don't have it, the sale stays with its shift pending reconciliation.
resolve.evidence: What you saw on the machine
resolve.evidencePlaceholder: E.g.: the screen says "Payment completed", $200 went in and it gave $50 change
resolve.owed: {{amount}} still needs to be returned to the customer.

motivos.DESCUENTO: the cash machine doesn't take sales with discounts
motivos.PC_REVOCADA: the PC had already been unpaired from the machine
motivos.SIN_SALDAR: what went in wasn't enough to pay the check
motivos.SIN_CARRITO: the payment arrived without its products
motivos.CARRITO_ILEGIBLE: the payment's products couldn't be read
motivos.VENTA_RECHAZADA: the sale could no longer be recorded (for example, a product no longer exists)
motivos.PREMIO_PENDIENTE: the payment included a stamp reward
motivos.LLAVE_OCUPADA: the folio already belonged to another sale
motivos.RESERVA: reservations and classes are not charged at the machine

resolve.changed: New evidence arrived: review it again.

errors.invalidAmount: Enter amounts in pesos, with up to 2 decimals.
errors.paidNeedsFull: For "It was paid", the amount received must be at least the amount due ({{due}}).
errors.changeTooHigh: It could not return more than {{max}} (received minus due).
errors.cancelNeedsLess: If it received the full amount due ({{due}}), the payment could not be cancelled: choose "It was paid".
errors.refundTooHigh: It could not return more than it received.
errors.keptMustBeZero: If it kept the money, the amount returned is $0.
errors.cancelModeMismatch: What the machine did with the money doesn't match what you chose above. Check the machine's screen.
errors.belowSeen: The machine already reported {{amount}} went in: you can't record less. Check the machine's screen.

conflict.title: This payment was already resolved as:

cancelMode.question: What did the machine do with the money?
cancelMode.unknown: If you don't know, leave the payment in doubt and check the machine's screen.

toFinish.label: Cash machine payment to finish: the machine already charged but the sale was not fully recorded
toFinish.intro: The machine already closed these payments and reported how they ended, but the sale was not fully recorded. Check what the machine reported and tap "Finish": it is recorded as is, without typing any amounts.
toFinish.title: Finish payment {{folio}}
toFinish.explain: It is recorded with what the machine already reported; you don't need to type anything. If something new arrives from the machine while you read it, we'll ask you to confirm again.
toFinish.noReceiptTime: No receipt time: the sale stays with its shift pending reconciliation.

incidents.heading: Other machine incidents
incidents.intro: The machine or its PC sent something that doesn't add up. Read what arrived and mark it as reviewed; that doesn't move any money.
incidents.title: Review incident {{folio}}

IMPOSIBLE.label: Impossible amounts
IMPOSIBLE.hint: The machine sent amounts that cannot be right, for example returning more than went in.

CONFLICTO.label: Reference with two versions
CONFLICTO.hint: This reference was already recorded differently or from another PC.

NO_SE_PUDO_REGISTRAR.label: Sale not recorded
NO_SE_PUDO_REGISTRAR.hint: The machine took the payment, but the sale could not be recorded (for example, a product no longer exists). The money is logged here.

TRAS_REVOCAR.label: Reference from an unpaired PC
TRAS_REVOCAR.hint: A reference arrived from a PC that had already been unpaired from the machine.

incidents.notePlaceholder: E.g.: I checked the machine and the receipt; the money matches the cash count
incidents.changed: New evidence arrived: review it again.
